units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70:12">Gen. R. s. 70</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:1">Ex. R. s. 5</cite>, a. e. <he>נ׳ של גדולה</he> the kiss of homage; <he>נ׳ של פרקים</he> the kiss of meeting again; <he>נ׳ של פרישות</he> the kiss of parting; <he>נ׳ של קריבות</he> the kissing of relations.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:9">Deut. R. s. 11</cite>, end <he>ונטל … בנְשִׁיקַת פה</he> and took his (Moses’) soul with a kiss of the mouth.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 17a:4">B. Bath. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מרים נמי בנ׳ מתה</he> Miriam, likewise, died with a (divine) kiss (without agony); <cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:12">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 8a:13">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ דמיא וכ׳</he> death without agony is like taking &c., v. <cite ref="B00656"><he>בִּינְתָא</he> II</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="N01319"><he>נְשִׁיקוֹת</he></cite>. Ex. R. l. c.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:5">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>מה״ש אמרוהו יתן לנו מנ׳ וכ׳</he> the ministering angels said the verse, ‘May he give us of those kisses which he gave to his sons’ (at Mount Sinai).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:5">Ib.</cite> <he>בסיני נאמרה יוציא לנו נ׳ מתוך פיהו</he> at Mount Sinai the verse was said (by the Israelites), ‘May he let kisses go forth to us out of his mouth’; a. e.
